lessons.cultural_notes: In English-speaking cultures, greetings vary by time of day (e.g., 'Good morning' before noon, 'Good evening' after 6 PM). A smile, wave, or handshake is common, especially in formal settings. Casual greetings like 'Hi' or 'What’s up?' are popular among friends.

content.text: In English-speaking regions, politeness is key in interactions. Phrases like 'please' and 'thank you' are commonly used to show respect and gratitude.

translations.ta-IN: ஆங்கிலம் பேசும் பகுதிகளில், இடைவினைகளில் மரியாதை முக்கியமானது. 'தயவுசெய்து' மற்றும் 'நன்றி' போன்ற சொற்றொடர்கள் பொதுவாக மரியாதையையும் நன்றியையும் காட்ட பயன்படுத்தப்படுகின்றன.
translations.hi-IN: In English-speaking regions, politeness is key in interactions. Phrases like 'please' and 'thank you' are commonly used to show respect and gratitude.
translations.te-IN: ఇంగ్లీష్ మాట్లాడే ప్రాంతాలలో, పరస్పర చర్యలలో మర్యాద కీలకం. 'దయచేసి' మరియు 'ధన్యవాదాలు' వంటి పదబంధాలు సాధారణంగా గౌరవం మరియు కృతజ్ఞతను చూపించడానికి ఉపయోగిస్తారు.
translations.en-IN: In English-speaking regions, politeness is key in interactions. Phrases like 'please' and 'thank you' are commonly used to show respect and gratitude.
